description: Labels every image in a folder automatically, with no training. Describe what to find in words, or label a few examples and let the model find the rest.

inputs.name: annotation_file
inputs.description: Optional. A file of labelled examples (e.g. from Smart Labeler). Connecting it fills in the Prompt file field for you.

outputs.name: annotations
outputs.description: The run's annotations_<model>_<timestamp>.json — filenames carry a timestamp, so the actual file is resolved (via a real Tapis directory listing once the job finishes) from inside the 'annotations' output directory rather than being a static path; see file_glob. The glob's '[!c]' deliberately excludes annotations_coco_<model>_<timestamp>.json (written alongside it when output_format is 'coco'/'both') by assuming the model name doesn't start with 'c' — true for every backend registered today (sam3). If that ever changes, or you specifically need the coco file with output_format='both', browse the run's archive directory manually instead of this port.

prompt_mode.description: How you tell the model what to find: type words, draw example boxes, or label a few images and let INSID3 find the same things in all of them.

text_prompts.description: What to look for, in plain words (e.g. tree, parked car). You can give each one its own output name, e.g. dog → german shepherd.

annotation_file.description: A file of labelled examples. A Smart Labeler or COCO export works as-is.

model.description: SAM3 finds objects from words or example boxes. INSID3 learns from a few labelled images and finds the same things in all the others.

model_id.description: Which version of the model to use. Leave blank for the recommended default.

insid3_weights.description: Leave blank to download the model automatically. Only set this if you already have the DINOv3 .pth file on the cluster.

insid3_image_size.description: Size each image (or tile) is processed at. 1024 is more accurate, 768 is faster.

reference_box_masks.description: For examples drawn as boxes only: 'sam3' outlines the object inside the box (more accurate), 'box' uses the whole box (faster).

min_area.description: Ignore detections smaller than this many pixels. 0 keeps everything.

max_shots.description: How many of your labelled examples to use per class. Aim for 5 or more that look different (sizes, lighting, growth stages).

insid3_mask_refiner.description: 'crf' gives sharper outlines that follow edges, best for small spots, but is slower and needs a GPU. 'bilinear' is the fast default.

insid3_crf_size.description: Higher gives sharper outlines but is slower. Keep it at or below the image size.

insid3_tau.description: Lower values split matches into smaller pieces, which can help with small spots. Default 0.6.

insid3_merge_threshold.description: Higher keeps only strong matches: fewer false detections, but faint ones may be missed. Default 0.2.

is_sahi.description: Split large images into smaller tiles. Helps find small objects, but takes longer.

tile_size.description: Size of each tile in pixels. For small spots, 384–512 works well.

overlap_ratio.description: How much neighbouring tiles overlap (0–1), so objects on a tile edge aren't cut off.

exemplar_tile_mode.description: 'intersecting' only searches tiles that contain an example box (faster). 'all' searches every tile.

exemplar_min_visibility.description: How much of an example box (0–1) must be inside a tile for it to be used there.

batch_size.description: Tiles processed at once. Higher is faster but uses more GPU memory.

confidence.description: Drop detections scoring below this (0–1). Raise it to cut false detections. Not used by INSID3.

mask_threshold.description: How tight object outlines are (0–1). Higher gives smaller, tighter outlines. Not used by INSID3.

nms_iou.description: How much two detections must overlap (0–1) to be merged into one.

class_agnostic_nms.description: Merge overlapping detections even when they came from different prompts.

no_segmentation.description: Output boxes only, without outlines. Faster.

output_format.description: 'flat' is this app's format, 'coco' is the standard COCO format, 'both' writes both.

max_images.description: Stop after this many images, handy for a quick test. 0 means all images.

hf_token.description: The saved secret holding your Hugging Face token, used to download the models. Your Hugging Face account must have accepted the model licenses (facebook/sam3, and facebook/dinov3-… for INSID3).

fileInputs.name: prompt_file
fileInputs.description: Optional: exemplar/text prompt JSON, staged in when annotation_file is set. Note this text is itself placeholder-substituted (job_spec renders every string leaf, descriptions included), so it deliberately spells no placeholder out literally. sourceUrl is the annotation_file value verbatim — always a full tapis://system/path URI, whether it came from this node's own config (the panel stores the system inside the URI, see zeroShotAnnotation.tsx) or from the wired 'annotation_file' input, which _resolve_inputs overrides the config value with at run time. Re-adding a 'tapis://' + system prefix here (as this did while the config key was still named prompt_file) doubles the scheme on the wired path.

fileInputs.name: dinov3_weights
fileInputs.description: insid3 only: the DINOv3 backbone checkpoint, staged in when insid3_weights is set. sourceUrl is the insid3_weights value verbatim — a full tapis URI, like annotation_file.
